class.name: CbLinkLook
class.brief_description: What the line of a motion's probe looks like: the rope of a grappling hook.
class.description: A [CbMotion] with a [CbProbe] throws a line from a player to what it looked at. This node says what that line is drawn as: [member scene], one metre long along its -Z, which the game stretches from the player to the line's end for as long as it is out, while it flies and while it holds. Put it in the mod's [code]vfx/reactions_<name>.tscn[/code], next to its [CbItemLook] and [CbReaction] nodes. Looks only. In conditions (a [CbReaction], a HUD node), [code]linked[/code] is true for a player whose line is out and [code]link_holds[/code] once it has taken hold.

members.member: The motion whose line this draws, by its set and node: [code]grapple.moves/Hook[/code]. Empty: any line that has no look of its own.
The rope: a scene one metre long along its -Z (a thin cylinder, a stretched quad). It is scaled along Z to the line's length.
The player's socket the rope starts at ([code]RightHand[/code], [code]LeftHand[/code], [code]Head[/code], or one the character has). Empty, or a socket the character does not have: its chest.
